events.title: Firmware Fellowship - October 2026
events.description:
Join us for Firmware Fellowship for our summer series! This technical discussion series focuses on embedded firmware development best practices and provides a forum for developers to share expertise and learn from each other. We meet in a casual setting to share what we know and to learn from you! Don’t be afraid to join us, there won’t be any pop quizzes!

Come nerd out with us on October 8th! We’ll be doing an open-source project review for a hydrostat controller project. You are welcome to bring your current projects, in any state of completion to share!

## Event Agenda
• 6:45 - Doors Open
• 7:00 - Technical presentation and/or discussion
• 7:45 - Wrap up and pick next month’s topic
• 8:00 - Event conclusion

events.title: Hardware Hangout - November 2026
events.description:
Join us for the final Hardware Hangout of the 2026 season! This networking event brings together embedded developers, electronics engineers, hobbyists, and industry supporters for technical discussions and community building. The topic for November is embedded in motion. How embedded systems are being used in, on, and around vehicles of all kinds. From cars and trucks to tractors, construction equipment, and everything in between, embedded systems are powering the vehicles we rely on every day.

Share your stories, tips, and questions with the group! Have an idea for what Iowans of Things could do next year? We’d love to hear it! We’re always looking for new ways to connect, learn, and strengthen Iowa’s embedded technology community.

## Event Highlights
• **Technical Talk:** Embedded in Motion: Share your projects and experiences using embedded systems in, on, and around vehicles of all kinds!
• **Networking:** Mingle with like-minded individuals, share experiences, and forge valuable connections
• **Project Share:** Bring your latest projects or ideas to spur conversations, or simply be inspired by others. Don’t worry, we won’t make anyone perform a show-and-tell!

## Who Should Come?
• Embedded software developers
• Firmware developers
• Electronics and electrical engineers
• Electronics and robotics hobbyists
• Product designers
• Automation engineers and techs
• Supporters of the industry
• Those looking to work in or hire people in the industry

## Event Agenda
• 4:30 - Arrive, park, grab refreshments
• 5:00 - Tech Talk & Open Discussion
• 5:45 - Share projects and mingle
• 6:30 - Wrap up and take off
